name: Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Boniato Mash
whyItWorks: Lean roasted pork tenderloin and creamy mashed boniato (white sweet potato) provide a soft, low-residue entrée at Plaza de Coco.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim off the outer pasilla-spice rub edge if sensitive to mild dried chile, enjoy the tender pork interior with the smooth boniato mash and maple jus, and skip the fried taro chips and Swiss chard.
watchOuts: Mild pasilla chile rub on the exterior (request plain roasted if flaring)
Sharp fried taro chips and leafy chard
